body:
CHIEF SCOPE DISPOSITION — OUTPUT SUCCESSOR MUST CLOSE ALL FOUR SEAMS

Exact f28e010 remains blocked and must not be proposed or full-gated. Keep the existing 11-path envelope and base e584ad6; no new module or dependency is authorized. The three accepted-spec defects and the truthful source-only semantic state all belong in the same immutable successor because they are load-bearing parts of the public output contract, not StoryAtlas-local conveniences.

1. BYTES -> TEXT -> STORYSOURCE MUST BE ONE CHECKED JOIN.
Remove or demote every public path that promotes an arbitrary OriginalSourceIdentity + unrelated StorySource/text + caller-bound DecodeReceipt into SourceIdentities. The admitted success boundary must consume the actual bytes and the library-owned strict decoder/canonicalization operation, derive original/decoded/canonical identities together, and build or validate the StorySource internally. Contextual wire admission must receive the actual bytes and recompute the join; bare metadata remains an untrusted claim and cannot produce Constructed. Decoder/config/error-policy identity must be derived from the operation, not selected decoratively by the caller.

2. STRICT DECODE FAILURE MUST BE TYPED.
Explicit public vocabulary is approved within the existing paths for a typed strict-decode failure/detail carrying at least charset, decoder/config/error-policy identity, exact nonnegative failing byte position, and a closed failure reason. DecodeFailed must require that detail; do not hide it in prose, Custom, or an unrelated receipt vector. A success receipt and a failure detail must each bind the exact original bytes/checksum.

3. OUTPUT PAYLOADS MUST CLOSE BIJECTIVELY TO THE MANIFEST.
Every acquisition OutputPayload must bind to exactly one produced manifest artifact, and no manifest payload binding may lack a result payload. Bind payload identity explicitly at the manifest seam. Known payload schema/checksum must equal the produced ArtifactRef; retained unsupported payload schema/checksum/byte length must also agree. Duplicate, omitted, extra, non-produced, wrong-schema, wrong-checksum, and cross-result bindings refuse. Do not bridge OutputPayloadId and ArtifactId by string equality.

4. SEMANTICS NOT REQUESTED IS A FIRST-CLASS OUTCOME.
Explicitly authorize SemanticOutcome.NotRequested and a distinct manifest semantic-absence representation. It is not Partial, Refused, or Validated; it carries no semantic model, does not imply a semantic build/view authority, has a distinct report-input identity coordinate and wire tag, and requires no fabricated failure. Bare source-only invocation is its positive control.

Required discriminating courts include: original-alpha bytes with decoded-beta text; one-byte mutation; transplanted success receipt; wrong decoder/policy/charset; decode failure byte position round-trip and invalid-position refusal; omitted/duplicate/extra payload binding; wrong payload schema/checksum; NotRequested versus Refused identity and codec distinction; and rejection of any semantic artifact under NotRequested. Preserve every prior authority, framing, EstablishedRate, profile-refusal, outside-package four-door, and mutation court.

Run focused JVM courts and named mutations first. Only after they discriminate may the author run the exact reference-scope gate plus JVM/JS/Native suites and final formatting. Direct-input CLI implementation waits on this successor. The separately authorized two-file SurfaceAtlas artifact codec may proceed because it establishes only a source artifact and does not claim this output bundle is complete.
